subject: mocode
title: Deterministic intent/constraint ledger survives compaction independently of the summarizer
one_why: extractUserDirectives harvests user intent/constraint lines with rules (not the summary model) and pins them across compaction generations, motivated by measured ~17% summarizer retention of user constraints (compact.ts:54-55,464); no other subject separates user-intent preservation from summarizer goodwill.

subject: mocode
title: Dual-pressure ladder: 60% zero-LLM deterministic cleanup, 80% commits to LLM compact with no per-stage re-check
one_why: Nuance vs existing tiering entries: a low-pressure band does only idempotent cost-free rewrites, and crossing 80% deliberately commits the step to compacting rather than re-evaluating after each stage - anti-oscillation rule stated at scheduler.ts:147-149.

subject: mocode
title: Compaction fork reuses the parent request prefix so the summarizer call itself is a cache hit
one_why: Summarizer forks parent system+history and appends only the compact instruction; auto-falls back to a standalone compressor when the fork would not fit the window - turns compaction from a guaranteed cache miss into a cache read.

subject: mocode
title: Fingerprint-scoped grants that never migrate legacy tool-wide authority
one_why: Grants bind exact-command/resource-path hashes with once/session/project scopes, off-TTY denies fail-closed, dangerous tools default the panel to DENY, and v2 allowForever is intentionally not migrated so an upgrade cannot silently restore whole-tool authority.

subject: mocode
title: realpath-based jail incl. the new-file nearest-existing-ancestor case, centrally enforced
one_why: One policy choke point rewrites args.path into the jail for all path tools; symlink-out-of-root and new-file-ancestor-aliasing escapes are covered with real-symlink tests - the completeness checklist ('new path tool must be registered') is explicit.

subject: mocode
title: Project-sourced skills gated by content hash with fail-closed non-TTY
one_why: Trust is sha256 over SKILL.md+scripts+references, invalidated on content change, user-dir skills exempt, untrusted project skill execution in pipes/CI strictly denied - registry-skill payload threat treated as real.

subject: mocode
title: Hand-shaped SSE chunk stub drives the full stream-tool-refeed loop with byte-level assertions
one_why: Mock chunks mirror the real provider parse path (delta.content / delta.tool_calls / trailing usage) and assert history structure and hook ordering are reproducible, giving loop-regression safety without any API spend; plus 300-case property tests on the budget evaluator (context-budget.test.ts:164,200).

subject: mocode
title: 61-task coding benchmark exists but CI gates only the offline smoke
one_why: The fixture suite (basic/hard/advanced incl. concurrency, atomicity, protocol-parsing tasks) with independent verifiers is exactly what an evals-in-CI rung needs, but it requires a live key and never runs in CI; only the zero-model smoke is gated.

subject: mocode
title: Atomic full-history checkpoint per tool batch with resume-job in a new process
one_why: Background jobs tmp-write+rename the entire history after each committed tool batch, so a crash or reboot resumes from the last batch boundary via mocode resume-job - crash recovery scoped to jobs rather than the interactive session.

subject: mocode
title: Immutable per-step tool-policy snapshots with explicit add_tool_groups expansion and an optional small-model router
one_why: Schema, runtime backstop, and sub-agent permissions all derive from one per-step non-expansible snapshot; mid-step group expansion only takes effect next step, and a probability-threshold classifier can pre-select groups - expansion is a versioned, traced, tested state transition (tool-policy.test.ts:144-246).

subject: mocode
title: Command denylist and env-secret filter are bypassable by construction - but honestly labeled non-boundary
one_why: Source states 'not a security boundary' and lists its own bypasses ($IFS/base64/env concat); the honesty is the model, the mechanism is not - real isolation still needs an OS jailer, which this project defers.

subject: mocode
title: Provider-reported usage calibrates the token estimator (EWMA with outlier rejection) and ephemeral injections count toward pressure
one_why: Nuance vs existing entries: samples with ratio <0.3 or >3.5 vs estimate are discarded, and out-of-history tail injections are passed in explicitly so fixed overhead is invisible to the 80% pressure line; a real 289k/256k overflow regression is pinned by test.

subject: mocode
title: Sub-agents reuse the parent's exact wire prefix - byte-equality asserted by test
one_why: Delegation strips only the trailing assistant tool_call message, appends the task text, and keeps identical tools/system prompt, so the sub-agent's first request is a prefix-cache hit on the parent's already-sent bytes; test also forbids added restriction phrasing that would fork the prefix.
